verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe AI-driven browser agents that start from a single API call and can be watched live, with built-in Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and BrowserUse agents. HyperAgent's page.ai() takes multi-step natural-language goals such as "search for flights from Miami to LAX, select the cheapest option" in place of selectors. missing for 10: explicit evidence of form-filling flows, documentation depth on task completion and reliability (step limits, error handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end task success.
